title: Power Platform admin center - Reporting API for Copilot Credits (preview)
body:
We are announcing the Reporting API for Copilot Credits in Power Platform admin center. This feature is now available in public preview.

How does this affect me?
This feature enables you to access Copilot Credit usage from Copilot Studio through the Power Platform API.

The new API methods provide insights on usage by resource, environment, user, and feature. Details on how to use these of the new API methods can be found here.

Admins may leverage these reports for more insight on Copilot Studio usage. These read-only reports can be used along with Power Platform API credit allocations to monitor and optimize resources and environments that consume Copilot Credits.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

For more information, please visit:- Manage costs for agents powered by the GitHub Copilot harness- Manage Copilot Credits and capacity for Copilot Studio
